cohort: Patients with a twin or singleton pregnancy who underwent a trial of labor at ≥34 weeks gestation in a single center (2015-2022)
finding: Twin pregnancies are associated with a greater risk of intrapartum cesarean delivery compared to singleton pregnancies, particularly due to a higher risk of failure to progress.
mod_finding: In twin pregnancies, nulliparity, birthweight discordance >20%, and labor induction were associated with a higher risk of intrapartum cesarean delivery.
